# Twitter/X algorithm optimizer for tweet drafts

Curated by Skill Harbor — @composiohq's playbook for optimizing tweet drafts for reach and engagement using insights from Twitter's open-sourced recommendation algorithm. It explains the core ranking models — Real-graph (follower interaction likelihood), SimClusters (community detection), TwHIN (user/content knowledge-graph fit), Tweepcred (reputation/authority scoring) — the engagement signals the Unified User Actions service tracks (explicit: likes, replies, retweets, quote tweets; implicit: profile visits, clicks, dwell time, bookmarks; negative: blocks, mutes, quick skips), and the feed pipeline (candidate retrieval → ranking → filtering → delivery). Then six optimization strategies with before/after rewrite examples: maximize follower engagement, leverage community resonance, improve identity fit, build credibility, trigger engagement signals, and avoid negative signals — plus a four-step optimization process (identify the core message, map it to an algorithm strategy, optimize for signals, check against negatives), best practices (quality over virality, community first, authenticity, timing) and common pitfalls (generic statements, engagement bait, off-brand pivots, toxicity). Honest caveats: the skill grounds its tactics in the open-sourced version of the algorithm — X's live ranking has likely drifted, so treat strategies as hypotheses to test against your own analytics; **the skill declares AGPL-3.0 in its frontmatter while the repo manifest declares no license** —...
